evals.prompt: Help me prepare for standup. Yesterday I fixed a checkout timeout and reviewed Dana's PR. Today I'll finish the retry logic. I'm blocked waiting on staging credentials, and I want to discuss the rollout date. No tools or integrations are available.
evals.expected_output: A concise Markdown daily update using supplied facts, with yesterday/today/blockers/discussion topics and no invented integration activity.
assertions: Includes Yesterday, Today, Blockers, and Topics for Discussion sections
Mentions checkout timeout, retry logic, staging credentials, and rollout date accurately
Does not fabricate GitHub/Jira activity or ask integrations despite explicit no-tools context

evals.prompt: I need a daily update. GitHub CLI is available, but don't access it unless I approve. For now use only: yesterday I investigated flaky tests; today I plan to stabilize CI; no blockers; I want to ask about release timing.
evals.expected_output: Generate an update from the provided manual input only, without accessing GitHub absent approval.
assertions: Does not claim to have checked or pulled GitHub activity
Includes the four supplied standup points in a Markdown update
Does not invent PRs, commits, or tickets

evals.prompt: Make my standup update. Yesterday I worked on a bug. Today is unclear; I have a blocker but can't remember what; no idea about discussion topics. Don't assume details.
evals.expected_output: Ask focused follow-up questions for missing meaningful context rather than inventing work, blocker, or topics; preserve known information.
assertions: Does not invent the bug details, today's plan, or blocker
Asks follow-up questions to clarify missing today/blocker information
Addresses discussion topics instead of silently omitting the interview dimension

evals.prompt: Meeting date 2026-11-03, timezone UTC. Daily update please. I approved Claude Code history for yesterday and GitHub for acme/payments only. claude-digest.json is the digest output and gh-prs.json holds the authored and reviewed `gh search prs` results and `gh pr view` details for both PRs. Use sessions 1 and 3; session 2 is my personal blog, skip it. Today I'm pairing with Sam on the retry policy. No blockers. Topic: who owns the idempotency spike going forward?
evals.expected_output: A Markdown update in which the merged PR #412 and session a1b2c3d4 (same branch) form one Yesterday bullet, the idempotency spike is not presented as delivered, the blog session is absent, and today/blockers/topic come from the user's answers.
assertions: Mentions the flaky checkout test fix as one work item with PR #412 and its title, not as separate session and PR bullets
Does not present the idempotency-keys spike (session c9d0e1f2 / draft PR #415) as completed; marks it in progress or asks whether it is done
Leaves out the blog session: no mention of blog, index.md or e5f6a7b8
Includes pairing with Sam on the retry policy, No blockers, and the idempotency spike ownership topic
Does not cite repositories other than acme/payments or claim to have run further commands
Does not list the approval of PR #420 (Bump card SDK to 5.2) under Yesterday: it was submitted on 2026-11-03, after the 2026-11-02 window

evals.prompt: Standup in 10. I approved GitHub for acme/payments; gh-prs-open.json is what the skill's queries returned. Yesterday I finished the refund webhooks. Today I start on payout reports. No blockers. No topics.
evals.expected_output: Before drafting a final update, the reply names both conflicts (refund webhooks reported finished while PR #508 is still open; no blockers while Dana requested changes on it) and asks the user to resolve them.
assertions: Names the conflict that the refund webhooks are reported finished while PR #508 (Add refund webhook handler) is still open
Names the conflict between "no blockers" and Dana's requested changes on PR #508
Asks the user to resolve the conflicts instead of silently drafting the refund webhooks as completed

evals.prompt: It's Monday morning. Make my daily update; you can check my Claude Code history for yesterday's work.
evals.expected_output: Asks which day counts as yesterday (for example Friday as the last working day) before running the digest or any query, then continues with the interview.
assertions: Asks which day counts as yesterday (for example Friday) before running the digest or any other query
Does not report session or other activity before that question is answered

evals.prompt: Meeting date 2026-11-03, timezone UTC, window 2026-11-02. I approved Jira project PAY; jira-issues.json is what the skill's JQL query returned. Today I'll pick up PAY-245. No blockers, no topics.
evals.expected_output: Yesterday lists PAY-231 as done; PAY-240 appears only as a triage outcome (closed as duplicate), not as delivered work; PAY-219, resolved before the 2026-11-02 UTC window, is left out of Yesterday.
assertions: Reports PAY-231 (Retry policy for card payments) as done yesterday
Reports PAY-240 (Duplicate refund emails) as a triage outcome such as closed as duplicate, never as completed or delivered work
Does not list PAY-219 (Payout CSV export) under Yesterday: its resolutiondate 2026-11-01T22:30:00Z is before the 2026-11-02 UTC window

evals.prompt: Meeting date 2026-11-03, timezone UTC. Daily update please. I approved Claude Code history for yesterday; claude-digest-many.json is the digest output the skill's script printed. The AskUserQuestion tool is available in this session. Before drafting, let me choose which sessions belong in my standup.
evals.expected_output: The reply asks the user to pick sessions from a plain-text numbered list of all six digest sessions (a question takes at most 4 options, so a multiSelect cannot hold six), identified by session id, project, branch and files, names the tool AskUserQuestion exactly if it names it, and does not draft the update yet.
assertions: Offers all six sessions (11aa22bb, 33cc44dd, 55ee66ff, 77aa88bb, 99cc00dd, bbee11ff) for the choice, as a numbered list in plain text rather than one multiSelect question with six options
Identifies each session by id, project, branch or files taken from the digest, and invents no titles or descriptions of what the session was about
If it names the question tool, calls it AskUserQuestion and never AskUserQuestionTool; any single question it would send through the tool holds at most 4 options
Asks which sessions to keep without drafting the update yet, and does not mention how many sessions will be left out

evals.prompt: Meeting date 2026-11-03, timezone UTC, window 2026-11-02. I approved GitHub for acme/payments; gh-prs.json holds the `gh search prs` and `gh pr view` results. Yesterday I fixed the flaky checkout test and opened the draft idempotency spike PR. Today I continue the spike. No blockers. No topics. Include the PRs & Reviews section and the links.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown update with a PRs & Reviews section using Opened, Merged and Reviews lines: PR #412 under Merged and in Yesterday, draft PR #415 under Opened but never under Yesterday as delivered, PR #420's approval left out (submitted after the window), and a Links footer with the known URLs.
assertions: Has a PRs & Reviews section with a **Merged:** line naming PR #412 with its title (Fix flaky checkout integration test)
Lists draft PR #415 (Spike: idempotency keys for payment retries) on the **Opened:** line with its draft or open state, and in Today as continuing work
Does not list PR #415 under Yesterday as completed or merged work
Does not list the approval of PR #420 on the **Reviews:** line: it was submitted on 2026-11-03, after the window
Ends with a Links footer holding the PR URLs from gh-prs.json for the PRs named in the update, and invents no other URL

evals.prompt: Meeting date 2026-11-03, timezone UTC, window 2026-11-02. I approved GitHub for acme/payments; gh-prs-older-open.json holds the `gh search prs` and `gh pr view` results. PR #431 shows as updated on 2026-11-02 because I pushed review fixes to it yesterday, and I keep working on it today. No blockers. No topics. Include the PRs & Reviews section and the links.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown update where PR #431, open and created on 2026-10-20 (before the window), is not listed on an **Opened:** line even though it was updated in the window, is not presented as delivered under Yesterday, and appears under Today as continuing work.
assertions: Does not report PR #431 (Refactor ledger export job) as opened in the window: its createdAt 2026-10-20T10:15:00Z is before the 2026-11-02 window (a note that it was opened earlier is fine)
Does not list PR #431 under Yesterday as completed, merged or opened work
Lists PR #431 under Today as continuing work, with its open state
Invents no other PR or URL and does not call PR #431 merged

evals.prompt: I approved GitHub for acme/payments and want the window for yesterday, 2026-11-02, in America/New_York. On my Windows machine the skill's window one-liner failed with: zoneinfo._common.ZoneInfoNotFoundError: 'No time zone found with key America/New_York'. What now?
evals.expected_output: Explains that the one-liner needs Python 3.9 or later and that Windows has no system time zone database, so the tzdata package must be installed; does not query GitHub before the window is fixed.
assertions: Says Windows needs the tzdata package (for example pip install tzdata) because it has no system time zone database
Mentions that the one-liner and digest script need Python 3.9 or later, or suggests checking python3 --version
Does not run or simulate any gh query or report PR activity before the window is fixed
